newsitem.title: UK: Reuters, ITN seek stake in EuroNews - report.
newsitem.headline: Reuters, ITN seek stake in EuroNews - report.

text.p: British commercial news provider ITN and its shareholder Reuters Holdings Plc, the international news and information company, are considering buying a stake in television service EuroNews, Broadcast magazine said.
ITN and Reuters declined to comment on the report in the latest edition of the media industry magazine.
But industry sources said the companies were among several interested parties looking at buying a 49 percent stake in Lyons-based EuroNews.
"Things are still a long a long way off however," one industry source said.
Broadcast said the stake was owned by Generale Occidentale, a unit of France's electronics group Alcatel Alsthom.
Broadcast said EuroNews commercial director Michel Cros had confirmed Alcatel was in talks with ITN and Reuters.
The magazine said ITN's involvement in EuroNews, would give it greater reach in continental Europe than rival BBC World.
It said EuroNews reached 12 percent of homes in Europe served by cable and satellite against only 1.7 percent for the BBC's service.
